# 74221 - Dual monostable multivibrator (pin compatible with 74123)

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74221.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74221.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 40 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74221 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74221.png) | ![74221 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74221.png) | ![74221 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74221.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| 11 | /2CLR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); overriding clear: low ends the pulse, Q low; a rising edge with A low and B high also fires |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13,5 | Q = pulse state (high for tw after a trigger) | Q goes high for tw = Cext * Rext * ln2 (about 0.7 Cext Rext) after a trigger; not retriggerable; once fired it ignores A and B. |
| 4,12 | Q' = NOT Q | Complement output. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 1

Changes on: trigger edge on A or B, or rising edge of CLR'

- CLR' low: Q = L, Q' = H at once, regardless of A and B
- A high or B low (steady): no trigger, Q = L
- CLR' high, A low, B rising: one output pulse
- CLR' high, A falling, B high: one output pulse
- CLR' rising, A low, B high: one output pulse
- Pulse width tw(out) = Cext Rext ln2 ~ 0.7 Cext Rext; once fired the output no longer depends on A and B; not retriggerable
- Cext = 0, Rext = 2 kohm gives typically 30 ns

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| notes | SN74221: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. B input Schmitt: VT+ typ 1.55 V max 2 V, VT- min 0.8 typ 1.35 V; A input VT+ typ 1.4 max 2, VT- min 0.8 typ 1.4 V. Input edge rate: B min 1 V/s, A min 1 V/us. Rext 1.4-40 kohm, Cext 0-1000 uF. Duty cycle max 67% at Rext 2 kohm, 90% at max Rext. IIL A -1.6 mA, B and clear -3.2 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, Cext 80 pF, Rext 2 kohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Q | PLH | 45 | 70 |
| B | Q | PLH | 35 | 55 |
| A | Q' | PHL | 50 | 80 |
| B | Q' | PHL | 40 | 65 |
| CLR' | Q | PHL |  | 27 |
| CLR' | Q' | PLH |  | 40 |

| setup | CLR' inactive | trigger | 15 |
| outputPulseWidth | Q |  |  |

## Not known

- Typical clear-to-output delays are not printed (only max).
- No minimum propagation delays printed.

## Notes

Pin-compatible with the 74123 except that it does not retrigger.
